items.title: Caterpillar Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: First-quarter 2026 sales and revenues increased 22% to $17.4 billion; CEO said record backlog provides a strong foundation for continued positive momentum. The release also lists key risks including tariffs, demand fluctuations, competitive pressure, dealer inventory decisions, and supply-chain disruptions.

items.title: Caterpillar Reports Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results
items.snippet: Full-year 2025 sales and revenues were $67.6 billion. The company said it expects 2026 sales and revenues to grow around the top end of its 5% to 7% CAGR target versus 2025.

items.title: CATERPILLAR INC. (annual report / Form 10-K via SEC)
items.snippet: Annual report references 2026 services growth driven by increasing energy demand supporting data-center build-out and notes backlog remaining comparable to record 2025 performance; includes Risk Factors.

items.title: cat-20260331 (SEC filing / quarterly report)
items.snippet: SEC quarterly report; identifies highlights for the first quarter of 2026 and references risk factors from the 2025 Form 10-K.
